statement: sweep and reclaim in one bar: high > L + delta and close < L (short at prior high); mirror at prior low (long). Stop = bar extreme +/- 0.05*ATRd.
mechanism: stop-run/liquidity (A1/A3) or breakout continuation (A2) at HTF levels
falsification: identical to config/htf_protocol.json (DEV Sharpe >= 0.5 & expectancy > 0 & >= 60% instruments positive; VAL Sharpe >= 0.3; TEST single look > 0 at 1x and >= 0 at 2x; FRESH expectancy > 0)
